u3: The agent is at the exit while holding the box, and any fall that occurred has been recovered. All task requirements are satisfied, so this is successful completion and no further action is needed.
u4: The agent has reached the exit empty-handed while a fall remains unresolved, so the box must still be picked up and held. This is not a failure; regaining the box and holding it satisfies the outstanding recovery and completes the task. Until then, the exit visit does not count as success.
